text:
```yaml
name: Labeler
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  labeler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: First interaction
        uses: actions/first-interaction@v3
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          issue_message: |
            Thanks for opening your first issue here! Be sure to follow the issue template and provide as much detail as possible.
          pr_message: |
            Thanks for opening this pull request! Please check out our contributing guidelines and make sure to follow the pull request template.
```
